Visit the shield house in Ordon Village at night. Use the Gale Boomerang or Clawshot to retrieve the pickup from the grass on its ledge.
Find the gated chest beside the four pinwheels. Target all four with the Gale Boomerang in the order shown by the Z-shaped floor marking, then open the chest.
Talk to Coro at his camp beside the house in South Faron Woods to receive his first gift.

Reach Ganondorf beyond the Hyrule Castle throne room and finish the final boss sequence. Complete the duel and deliver the finishing blow.
Recover the four Poe flames to open the central barrier. Continue into the passages beyond it to reach the Big Key chest.
At night, search beneath the tree in the central part of Faron Field. Reveal the Poe with Wolf Link's senses, defeat it, and take its soul.
Use hawk grass on the high village ledges to send a hawk at the monkey holding the cradle. Carry the cradle to Uli, then follow her home for the reward.
Fish at the dock beside the cat until it takes a fish and runs home. Follow it to Sera's shop and talk to Sera for the reward.
Visit Mayor Bo in Ordon Village and complete his sumo lessons. After winning the matches, open the chest he offers.
Look up into the tree branches near the central bridge in Faron Field. Target the pickup with the Gale Boomerang to bring it to you.
From Kakariko Gorge, aim the Gale Boomerang at the pickup on top of the tall rock spire beside the bridge.
At the southern end of Kakariko Village, destroy the high rocks with Bomb Arrows, then retrieve the exposed pickup with the Gale Boomerang.
Talk to Renado inside Kakariko's sanctuary to receive his letter reward when the seed's Ilia-quest requirements are met.
Find Shad in the basement beneath Renado's sanctuary in Kakariko Village. Show him the Ancient Sky Book and finish the conversation.
Visit Ralis at the Zora tomb in Kakariko Graveyard. Show him Ashei's Sketch and finish his dialogue to receive the reward.
Speak to the elder outside Kakariko Malo Mart to start the delivery. Carry the hot springwater barrel across the field and throw it onto the exhausted Goron at the Castle Town bridge before it cools.
Visit Impaz in the Hidden Village after clearing the Bulblins. Show her the Dominion Rod and finish her dialogue to receive the Sky Book reward.
As Wolf Link, speak to the Hidden Village Cucco and find all 20 cats. Report back, then collect the prize in front of Impaz's house.
Defeat the 20 Bulblins in the Hidden Village, then speak to Impaz inside her house for the reward.
Visit Telma's Bar in Castle Town's southern street. Show Renado's Letter to Telma to receive the Invoice reward.

Show the Invoice to the doctor and learn the medicine scent from the crate in his office. Follow the scent to Louise, then defeat the Stalhounds outside Castle Town's south gate at night and collect their drop.
Speak to Plumm at Lake Hylia as Wolf Link. Ride the bird through the river course, popping fruit balloons; build a streak on matching fruit to score at least 10,000 points.
Rent Hena's boat and approach the rock formation in the fishing pond. Cast the lure at the pickup on the ledge to reel it in.
Defeat Ook in the Forest Temple miniboss room. Roll into his pillar when he is off balance, attack while he is down, and collect the reward after the fight.
Defeat Dangoro in the miniboss arena, using Iron Boots to hold your ground and throw him off the platform when he curls up. Open the chest in the room beyond.
Defeat Deku Toad: clear the small toads, avoid its landing, and attack its exposed tongue. Open the reward chest after the fight.
Cut the ropes holding the sword to start the fight. Use Wolf Link's senses to attack the spirit, then fight its revealed form as Human Link. Open the chest after winning.
Defeat King Bulblin in Hyrule Castle's west courtyard and collect the reward he gives after the fight.
In Lanayru Field, find the wooden barriers underwater south of the stone bridge. Break through them with an underwater attack, then use Iron Boots to reach and open the chest.
Enter the cave in Lanayru Field and solve its sliding-block puzzles. Position the blocks so you can reach the switches and continue to the chest at the back.
In Goron Mines' outdoor area, sink into the water with Iron Boots. Break the wooden barrier with an underwater attack and open the chest beyond.
In Goron Mines' outdoor area, use the Clawshot targets toward the north side to reach the raised chest.
In Lakebed Temple's central staircase room, Clawshot onto the chandelier platform and open the chest on it.
In the central room, use a Bombling to break the boulder beneath the north door. If the staircase blocks the chest, extinguish its torches with the Gale Boomerang.
From the room east of the Windless Bridge, pass the Tile Worms and climb the vines to the chest ledge.
Climb to the upper lobby. Strike the chandeliers with the Ball and Chain to make them swing, then jump across them to the chest.
From the upper wooden beams, set the chandelier swinging with the Ball and Chain. Jump onto it and across to the chest ledge.
In the northeastern room, reach the upper level and swing the chandelier with the Ball and Chain. Jump across to the chest.
